entries.title: Minimum marks for admission
entries.question: What are the minimum marks required for admission?
entries.answer: A minimum of 50% marks in intermediate is required for admission (Fall 2026 admissions page).

entries.title: Mathematics requirement for BS programs
entries.question: Is mathematics required for BS programs?
entries.answer: Mathematics is the basic eligibility requirement for BS programs. Students who did not study mathematics take 6 credit hours of deficiency courses.

entries.title: Eligibility for Computer Science programs (F.A and I.Com)
entries.question: Can F.A or I.Com students apply for Computer Science programs?
entries.answer: Students with F.A or I.Com are not eligible for Computer Science programs.

entries.title: Entry test
entries.question: How does the entry test work?
entries.answer: Entry tests are walk-in. Some programs need no entry test and admit students on merit.

entries.title: Faculties at LGU
entries.question: Which faculties does LGU have?
entries.answer: LGU has four faculties: Social Sciences, Computer Sciences, Languages and Basic Sciences.

entries.title: Main campus address
entries.question: Where is the LGU main campus?
entries.answer: The LGU main campus is in Sector C, DHA Phase 6, Lahore.

entries.title: Published university policies
entries.question: Where can I find the university policies?
entries.answer: LGU publishes its policies as PDF documents on the Policies page of its website. They include the Student Handbook, the Admission Policy (Undergraduate and Graduate), the Undergraduate Education Policy, the Financial Assistance and Scholarship Policy, the Grievances Management Policy, the Hostel SOP and the Anti-Plagiarism Policy.
